title: The Other Guys
tagline: The desk cops get the case. And the takeaway.
about: Two mismatched New York desk detectives finally get a real case and try to prove they are more than paperwork.
cue: Serve the snacks when Allen and Terry leave the desk for the street.

    StartersDesk pop smoked salmon bagel bitesMini bagels with caper dill cream cheese, smoked salmon, pickled onionHow to make it1 red onion80ml white vinegar1 tbsp sugar200g cream cheese1 tbsp capers1 bunch dill1 lemon8 mini bagels200g smoked salmonSlice the red onion thin and cover with the white vinegar, the sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes.Beat the cream cheese with the chopped capers, the chopped dill and lemon zest.Split and toast 8 mini bagels.Spread each half with the cream cheese, fold on smoked salmon, top with drained pickled onion and dill and grind over pepper.Hoitz's pakorasCrisp chickpea fritters with onion and spinach, mint yoghurtHow to make it150g chickpea flour1 jar ground cumin1 jar chilli powder2 onions100g spinach200g Greek yoghurt1 bunch mint1 L vegetable oil180ml waterMix the chickpea flour, the cumin, the chilli, salt and the water into a batter.Stir in the sliced onions and the chopped spinach.Fry spoonfuls in the vegetable oil at 180°C for 4 minutes and serve with the yoghurt mixed with mint.Spinach and artichoke dip with pitaAllen's Prius, the official stakeout vehicle.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGamble's sesame tuna bowlsSeared tuna, avocado and edamame over rice. The lion loses.How to make it2 cups sushi ricerice vinegar, to taste1 tbsp sugar600g sashimi-grade tuna steaks60g sesame seedssoy sauce, to tastesesame oil, to tastewasabi paste, to taste200g frozen edamame2 avocados1 continental cucumberpickled ginger, to tasteCook the sushi rice and season with the rice vinegar and the sugar.Coat the tuna steaks in the mixed sesame seeds.Sear in a very hot oiled pan 45 seconds a side and slice.Whisk the soy, the rice vinegar, the sesame oil and a little wasabi.Boil the frozen edamame 3 minutes.Build bowls with rice, tuna, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and spoon over the dressing.SweetsBike messenger browniesFudgy dark chocolate brownies baked in a tin and cut in squaresHow to make it200g dark chocolate180g butter300g caster sugar3 eggs100g plain flour30g cocoaMelt the dark chocolate with the butter.Whisk in the sugar and the eggs, then fold in the flour and the cocoa.Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170°C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.DrinksGator's whiskey sourFoamy bourbon sour with lemon, bitters and a cherryHow to make it200ml bourbon4 lemons80ml sugar syrup2 eggs1 tsp aromatic bitters4 maraschino cherries4 cups iceFor each drink, put the bourbon, the lemon juice, the sugar syrup and a little egg white in a shaker.Shake without ice for 10 seconds to build the foam, then add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds more.Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.Add a few drops of aromatic bitters on the foam and a cherry.For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for cold black tea.Fresh pineapple juiceAim for the bushes.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
